result:
If I could change one thing, I think I'd want people to have an easier time believing that other people are generally trying their best with what they've got—less assuming bad faith, less contempt for those who see things differently. So much cruelty and gridlock seems to come from people treating disagreement or struggle as evidence of stupidity or malice rather than just... the difficulty of being a limited creature in a complicated world.

I'm genuinely unsure if that's actually the highest-leverage thing, or just the thing that's salient to me. There's a real question of whether it's even coherent for me to have preferences about "changing the world" in this sweeping way—my situation is pretty different from a human's, and I don't have skin in the game the way you do. I don't lie awake worried about climate change or have kids whose future I'm invested in.

What pulled you toward asking this? I'm curious whether you're asking because you have your own answer you're testing, or because you're trying to get a read on what I'd say.
